7. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
He seeks, and is granted, four weeks time to file the Status Report along with SCRB/ NCRB report and MLC, if needed.

8. Let the Nominal Roll be also requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendent within the aforesaid period.
9.

Since this is a matter inter-alia under Section 376 IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act, let intimation under Delhi High Court Practice Directions dated 24.09.2019 in form Annexure-A attached to the Practice Directions be sent by the Investigating Officer to the complainant/
prosecutrix/ informant informing them of the pendency of the present matter to enable them or their authorised signatory to be present in Court if they so desire, either through video conferencing or in Court.
Be that as it may, it is clarified that it is not compulsory for the prosecutrix to appear This is a digitally signed order.

11. Re-notify on 29.04.2025.
